card.name: Second word of a compound noun phrase
card.fires_on: A noun or word part that completes the first half of a two-part term, such as 'reduction value', 'hemoglobin targets' or 'dead letters', just before the phrase's head or a following verb. Seen in both technical and medical text.

modes.label: Modifier noun in a term
modes.description: A noun that sits in the middle of a compound noun phrase, before the final noun or a linking word.
modes.example: calculate the ≥ 20% FEV1 reduction<< value>> before starting the methacholine challenge test

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: A piece inside a brand or medical word that is not yet complete.

modes.label: Word before a hyphen
modes.description: A word placed before a hyphen that forms a compound such as size-limited or Follow-Up.
modes.example: Baseline<< Follow>>-Up Renal Function Status N Normal n

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens; they hint weakly at what follows a noun phrase, away from option names like verbosity or enable.
card.plain: It marks a word in the middle of a two-part term, where the next word is expected to finish the phrase.
